r_C * G_C^-1 mod p = 73680319372475906803320245449080571569331871474977252785503402279627244902569 = rx_i ≡ CR1 * Gx_i mod p

BRIDGE:{ Px_i / Gx_i = CP1
	rx_i / Gx_i = CR1 }

therefore: {Px_i / rx_i = CP1 * CR1^-1 mod p}
